book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 KORIN Pol pepa muno namba 1 bogl Korin yomba tongwa

content: Pol pepa muno namba 1 bogl Korin yomba tongwa
Na Pol, Yesus Krais aposelmo moglka, i God yene prumere na di yungwa te nono angro Sosetenis akiye,

no pepa muno i bogltre ana ene God yombama Korin kamun suna meglkwa i tombuglka. Yesus Krais ere endungo ene holi meglko ana pinde yungo ye yombama meglkwa. Te yomba tau prapra makan koglkoglo mogl-eingwa i ye akiye Yaglkandeno Yesus kangiye dembiye karaugl erete meglkwa. Yesus Krais iwe, nono ya te yomba prapra Yaglkandeno moglkwa.
Nono Neno God te Yaglkande Yesus Krais wakaimo ya nomane pokndungwa i ene mina tenambiwo.
Pol ye God diwakai yeitongwa.
God ye Yesus Krais mina wakaimo ene tongwa ipre na poglodi pir ana engenge ene pre God diwakai yeite wanmoglka.
Ene Yesus Krais mina nomano suwara yeingwa i mina taragl prapra paitongo ombugl bitno pai pogl sungo te ene ka ake undi di wanmeglkwa.
I Krais kamo no boglo kugl tomunga i ene nomano suna duglo ongwa pre yegl eremeglkwa.
Te Spiritmo mina taragl gigle ingwa i kuno orko ene ta dokokre ana nono Yaglkandeno Yesus Krais unongugl enambuka pre suglmo meglkwa.
Te ye yombuglo bogl tenan ene gigle kuindi wanmoglpi ana Yaglkandeno Yesus Krais unambuka enge, ene mina aglau ta paikrambuka.
God taragl eragle dungwa i kaima kaima erambuka. Ye Wam Yesus Krais nono Yaglkandeno, ene ye bogl tapsi moraglkwa pre ene digaglkwa.
Korin God yombama poimsi meglkwa

Angrima wagle, nono Yaglkandeno Yesus Krais kangiye mina na ka giglendi ene diteinga, i ene prapra nomano suwara yei moraglmiwo, te nomano poglodi piraglkwa ya ka dinaglkwa i kokunkuno keunde panambiwo. Yegl erimbi ana ene mina suna poim sikraglimiwo.
Kaima angrima wagle, enene mina ka tengramo di meglkwa i Kloe yombama wagle boglo kugl narikwa.
Na ka ipre diga, enene mina suwara suwarandi ka yegl dingwa, “Na tau Pol yombamo.” Te ta dungwa, “Na Apolos yombamo.” Te ta dungwa, “Na Pita yombamo.” Te ta dungwa, “Na Krais yombamo.”
Krais ye poimsi wu perepere omo? Mo Pol ene pre ere endi-prak mina gogl suno? Mo Pol kangiye mina ene baptais ere suno?
Ene meglmara pukamugl yagl suwo Krispas ya Gaius keme na baptais ereteinga, ba yomba tau na ta baptais eretekrika. Ipre na God diwakai yeiteinga.
Yeglpre yomba ta eremogl ene Pol kangiye mina baptais erikura wa ta dikrambuka.
I kaima, na ama Stefanas yombama baptais ereteinga. Te yomba ta ama baptais ereteiyo mo eretekrika i na pirpogl sikrika.

Sraglpre, na yomba baptais eretenatnedi pre Krais diendekrukwa. Tamanga. Yesus kamo wakai dipene endinaglka pre na diendungwa. I makan yomba bitno pai pogl sungwa ka dimere yegl na dikraglka, ba na yegl dimbo ana Yesus endimo-prak kamo yombuglomo i taragl yoko mereyegl ere dinambiwo.
God nomanemo wakai ya yombuglomo i Krais moglkwa
Ana guglo kamun enaglkwa yomba ye endi-prak kamo i aglau ormedi pirkwa. Ba God ere-yungwa yomba nono prumga endi-prak kamo i God yombuglomo.
God kamo yegl beglko pangwa:

content.text: sungwa yomba ye nomano wakai ikorugl endinaglka.”

content: Nomano pirpogl singwa yomba meglma awe? Te yomba erme ka tengramo dingwa God lomo beke tongwa yomba meglma awe? Te enge erme taragl mambuno kaima pirpogl singwa yomba ye meglma awe? Makan yomba pirpogl singwa nomano wakai i God ere ikorugl endungo ye kanno i ka yoko orkwa.

Ana God ye nomano wakai mina ye yegl pirkan orkwa, makan yomba yene pirpogl singwa i mina God wedi pirkanpogl sikrikwa pango, ana God ye yomba ikine endinagledi pre konbauna ta i-pene endungwa. Ipre God kamo kinde kaima we dingwa ikra no dipene endumgo ana pirngi dingwa yomba God ere-yungwa.
Juda yomba kimagl kanamnedi yombuglo erikwa, te Grik yomba nomano wakai i pir inamunedi yombuglo erikwa,
ba no Krais endi-prak mina sigeglkwa i kamo dipene endumga. Ana Juda yomba ka i pirakuriko te Yomba Bina ka i kinde kaima wedi pirkwa.
Ba God i-ikine endungwa yomba, Juda ya Grik akiye nono pirkan ounga Krais ye God yombuglomo ya nomanemo moglkwa.

Makan yomba eremogl yegl pirkwa: God nomanemo wakai tau aglau kaima ormedi pirkwa, ba aglau ormedi pirkwa ikra pai mitna imbo ende yomba pirpogl singwa i engre tongwa. Te God yombuglo dokumedi pirkwa, ba i kaima gigle kuindi yomba gigle dingwa i i-atne endungwa.

Angrima wagle, ene okuna sraglmere wanmeglkwa enge, God aglendi yungo ene Kristen meglkwa i piryo. Okuna ene yomba merkinde makandle yomba nomano pirpogl singwa ikra ene mina ta paikrukwa. Te yomba merkinde yomburo paikruko te kangino kande paikrukwa.

Ba makandle pirpogl singwa yomba angai goraglmedi pre ye taragl aglau ormedi pirkwa taragl ikra God pinde yungwa. Te taragl yombuglo pame dingwa ikra angai goraglmedi pre taragl yombuglo komugl sungwa God pinde yungwa.

Te makandle yomba kangino paikrukwa ya gonduglme we dindre kongunmo paikrumedi pirkwa ikra God pinde yungwa. Ye yegl ormara i yomba gigle dingwa ya kangino kande pangwa ye wu taragl yoko mereyegl eingwa.
Yegl orkwa ipre yomba suwarata God ongumuglo mina ye yene pre dembiye sikrambuka.

God ye yene ene i-endungo Yesus Krais mina meglkwa. God yegl orko ana nono nomano wakai ya pirpogl sumga i mambuno Yesus moglkwa. Ye mina suwara nono wu du-yene omga, te yene mambunomo holi pamere wanmounga. Ye nono topo ere ikine endungwa.
Ipre kamambuno pepa mina muno yegl beglko pangwa:

content.text: sinagledi pirambuka, Yaglkande suwara dembiye si tenambuka.”
